title: # Preparedness and safety advice in case of wildfire
content:
**These tips are based on advice from MSB** 
You can get more information from krisinformation.se, the national information telephone number 11313 or emergency services on site.

sections.title: ## How can you protect your home from wildfires?
sections.content:
- Keep a managed lawn or incombustible surfaces around your entire house
- Avoid combustible material (firewood, garden residues or furniture) next to the façade
- Keep Thuja, cypress, juniper and spruce at some distance to the house or outbuilding
- Keep ceiling and gutters free from litter and moss
- Chimneys and vents covered with metal mesh
- Keep a long, flexible garden hose ready for use
- Prepare an emergency kit (e.g. ID, phone and charger, battery or crank radio, cash, first aid, personal medication, radio, flashlight)
- If you anticipate difficulty confining or evacuating (e.g., due to reduced mobility), inform the authorities or call 11313

sections.title: ## What to do if a wildfire approaches your home
sections.content:
- Go indoors, close all windows, doors and, if possible, ventilation
- Listen to Swedish Radio P4 or krisinformation.se if internet works
- If you have further questions, call the national information number 11313. In an emergency, call 112
- Prepare for possible evacuation. Localize your emergency kit, wear non-synthetic clothes with long sleeves and comfortable shoes

sections.title: ## What to do if evacuation is ordered
sections.content:
- Evacuation is always issued by emergency services or the police
- Authorities will issue a VMA - Viktigt Meddelande till Allmänheten (Important public Message)
- Pack important items. This may include ID documents, medications, aids such as glasses, warm clothes, cash, mobile phone + charger, keys, battery or crank radio + extra batteries, hygiene items, something to eat
